question: Does the exact-current dense c_fc direction concentrate in a task-selected directed sparse output action when reciprocal skew/shear tying and degree-regular perfect matchings are removed?
authorization: One zero-persistent-update directed-sparse bracket only. No training, learned basis, LoRA, HyperConnection, residual-topology change, larger rung, watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat is authorized.

protocol.selection: Compute the ridge-stabilized minimum-norm full output action B satisfying c_fc.T @ B approximately equal to the exact historical dense-Muon c_fc update. For each target expansion channel, select the largest 44 or 88 directed coefficients independently, then jointly refit only that target channel on the selected current weight columns.
protocol.structural_difference: Directed coefficients B[i,j] and B[j,i] are independent; source-channel degree is unconstrained. This removes both reciprocal skew/shear tying and perfect-matching degree regularity while using no learned basis or additive dense residual.
protocol.fixed_radius: Globally normalize every directed BF16 c_fc endpoint to the actual deployed production c_fc family Frobenius norm.
protocol.same_replay_state: Extract the dense historical c_fc oracle, exact production c_fc/c_proj updates, and production reconstruction from one gradient, clipped state, persisted momentum, functional context, and base model before fitting directed supports.
protocol.exact_restore: Restore every BF16 materialized MLP tensor around every candidate and persist zero model or optimizer updates to the checkpoint.

decision_rule.reliable_improvement: Candidate-minus-production 99% CI upper bound below zero and negative mean on every held-out window.
decision_rule.oracle_gate: Equal-radius dense c_fc must reliably beat production both alone and beside production c_proj on the new windows.
decision_rule.directed_pass: A directed level must reliably beat production both alone and beside production c_proj, recover at least 25% of the same-window dense c_fc oracle gap in the worse attribution, and at least 40% on average.
decision_rule.selection: Select 44 if it passes; otherwise select 88 only if it passes. A 44 failure and 88 pass identifies capacity within the new generator family. Neither pass authorizes training directly.
decision_rule.architecture_gate: A pass authorizes production implementation and an MFU preflight only; it does not directly authorize training or a larger rung.

execution.monitoring: direct foreground polling only; no watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat
